title: pi fork manifest
description: Inventory of fork-only patches. fork-drift-check.py evaluates every feature's drift probe against the upstream ref so absorbed features can be dropped; richer fork-sync.sh tooling derives its branch lists (independent, stacked, mergeIntoLocal) from this file. The runtime validator in fork-drift-check.py remains authoritative; this schema documents and type-checks the same shape for editors and reviewers.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to the manifest.

description.description: One-line summary of what the manifest inventories.

identity.description: Git identity to use for fork-authored commits.

upstreamRef.description: Default git ref probed by drift checks and merged by fork-sync.sh, e.g. "upstream/main".

integrationBranch.description: Branch that carries main plus every merged feature, e.g. "local".

notes.description: Free-form maintenance notes: scope decisions, retired branches, adoption prerequisites.

features.description: One entry per fork feature branch.

branch.description: Branch in this repository that carries the feature.

summary.description: What the feature changes, in one or two sentences.

base.description: Branch the feature is based on: "main" or another feature branch.

stackedOn.description: Base feature(s) this branch is stacked on; stacked branches are rebuilt, not rebased plain.

mergeIntoLocal.description: True when fork-sync.sh merges this branch into the integration branch. False for branches tracked but deliberately not merged.

drift.description: Probe that decides whether upstream absorbed the feature. ACTIVE = upstream lacks it; REDUNDANT = upstream has it, consider dropping the fork patch.

type.description: Probe kind. grep-* searches file for pattern; path-* tests a tree path; version-gte compares a JSON value in file against minVersion.

ref.description: Git ref to probe instead of the manifest upstreamRef.

file.description: Repository path probed by grep-*/version-gte. A missing file reports CHECK, not ACTIVE.

pattern.description: Regular expression searched in file (grep-absent, grep-present).

path.description: Repository path tested for existence (path-absent, path-present).

jsonPath.description: Dotted key path into file, used by version-gte.

minVersion.description: Semver the file's jsonPath value must reach for the feature to be REDUNDANT.

note.description: Why this probe, and when to flip the feature to REDUNDANT.
